sentences.text:
----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Manoj Purohit.

For Respondent(s) :
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati
Order 22/03/2023

1.  The present writ petition has been preferred by the petitioner claiming the following reliefs:-
I.

The respondent No.1 may kindly be directed to consider and early disposal of application (Annex.-6) for arbitration filed by the petitioner in respect of the lands comprised in Khasra 2138/1805 land measuring Rakba 0.1845 Hectare, commercial land situated in village Nawa, Patwar setra Nawa, Tehsil Nawa, District Nagaur.

II The respondent No.3 may kindly be directed to disburse total compensation amount that has already been determined by the respondents in pursuance of [2023/RJJD/007291] (2 of 3) [CW-3662/2023] the said award list and 24 % interest also be paid to petitioner.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in spite of the fact that the pleadings in the case are complete, the District Collector, Nagaur has not decided the said application and legal notice.

4. The present writ petition is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the petitioner to file an application for early hearing/disposal of the arbitration application, pending with the District Collector, Nagaur along with the copy of the order instant.

5. On receipt of the application and certified copy of the order instant, the District Collector, Nagaur shall decide the arbitration application expeditiously, in accordance with law, as early as possible,
preferably within a period of six months from the receipt of the application.

6. Needless to observe that the petitioner shall be free to move an application before the concerned Land Acquisition Officer for [2023/RJJD/007291] (3 of 3) [CW-3662/2023] disbursement of the total amount that has already been determined.
7.

In case, petitioner moves an application, the Land Acquisition Officer shall disburse the amount that has already been determined to the petitioner, as early as possible, preferably within a period of four weeks of receipt of the application.

8. Needless to observe that withdrawal of award amount shall not prejudice petitioner's case pending before the District Collector, Nagaur.
9.
Stay petition also stands disposed of accordingly.

(DR. PUSHPENDRA SINGH BHATI), J.
